title: Three Years and One Short Table
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（人与社会·科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（人与社会·科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：majority　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 majority 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the analyst ① won the majority that no resident in the district would have recorded, and he said the winning was the whole of the year. The ② majority, meaning the share itself and not the table, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a majority, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ majority in that district had the same short table beside it, and the ④ majority at the far desk, meaning the count they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A majority, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the analyst said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the majority was the whole of the matter, meaning the part and not the share. The ⑥ majority, meaning the part and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; majority, he said, is either something you win or the only word that means both a share and a part. He said the part is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ majority had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ majority of the whole thing, the analyst wrote in June, was one district and three years of recording; majority, he said, is either the count at the far desk or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ majority I remember is the share recorded in the chart, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ majority, my mother said in 2000, is the only share that improves by being recorded; every majority, she said, is a part that has agreed to look like a share. She said the part was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 多数；大多数（指街区里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 多数；大多数（指那个多数本身，与表格相对）
C. 固定搭配：win the majority 赢得这个多数
D. n. 多数；大多数（指留给孩子们核的那一项那一个）
E. n. 计数之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的多数之事）
F. n. 多数；大多数（指统计图表里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 大半、分量（指一件事里人人都数却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分量（抽象总称，指人人都数却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: won the majority that no resident in the district would have recorded
The majority, meaning the share itself and not the table
the majority at the far desk
the majority was the whole of the matter
the majority had become a line in a chart
The majority of the whole thing
A majority, my mother said in 2000

answers.why: win the majority 意为“赢得这个多数”，1991 年那位统计员把街区里没有一位居民肯记载的一个多数做了一遍。
majority 意为“多数；大多数”，指那个多数本身而不是表格，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被记载。
majority 意为“多数；大多数”，指街区里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一张小小的表格。
majority 意为“多数；大多数”，指最远那张案头留给孩子们核的那一项那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
majority 意为“大半、分量”，指一件事里人人都数却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个大半就是那件事的全部。
majority 意为“分量”，指人人都数却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个多数，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
majority 意为“多数；大多数”，指统计图表里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1996 年这一个成了统计图表里的一行。
majority 意为“计数之事”，统计员六月写道，整件事的多数之事是一处街区和三个年份的记载。
majority 意为“多数；大多数”，我记得的是统计图表里记载过的那一个，1998 年算完了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一个。
majority 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，多数是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的多数。
